images.description: Base CI image: everything else builds on top of it.
images.name: base

images.description: Docker Engine + buildx + compose, started at boot (builds and pushes images inside the job).
images.name: docker

images.description: Kubernetes tooling: kubectl, helm, kubeconform and kube-login (kubeconfig from the KUBECONFIG_DATA secret).
images.name: kube

images.description: Python 3 with uv, pipx and build headers.
images.name: python

images.description: Security scanners: Trivy (vulnerabilities, misconfig, secrets), Gitleaks (secrets), Semgrep (SAST).
images.name: security

templates.description: Installs or upgrades a Helm release (rolled back automatically if it does not become ready).
templates.name: deploy/helm

templates.description: Applies Kubernetes manifests (or a kustomization), optionally sets the image and waits for the rollout.
templates.name: deploy/kubectl

templates.description: Deploys files over SSH with rsync and optionally runs a remote command.
templates.name: deploy/ssh

templates.description: Builds a Docker image and optionally pushes it (push: "true"; REGISTRY_USER/REGISTRY_PASSWORD secrets if the registry needs login).
templates.name: docker/build

templates.description: Validates Kubernetes manifests, kustomizations and Helm charts against the API schemas (no cluster needed).
templates.name: k8s/validate

templates.description: Gitleaks: hardcoded secrets in the code and in the fetched git history.
templates.name: scanners/gitleaks

templates.description: Semgrep: static analysis (SAST) with the community rule sets.
templates.name: scanners/semgrep

templates.description: Trivy: vulnerabilities in dependencies, IaC misconfigurations and secrets in the repository.
templates.name: scanners/trivy
